answer: New identities dock at a harbor quarantine: fourteen days of unpaid relay work ferrying challenge packets between shards before any reward seat opens. The quarantine log is the relic, a tamper-evident chain countersigned by the shards served, so a farm cannot rewrite service history. Buying pre-aged identities fails because each transfer halves the relic's days, and an orchard of fresh clones starts from zero behind honest newcomers. Attack cost is fourteen idle days per clone, compute spent with nothing harvested, while an honest agent pays once and keeps the seniority.
